policy: Encoding prerequisites enter used features before psABI level selection: VEX/XOP imply avx+osxsave, EVEX implies avx512f+osxsave, narrow EVEX vectors also imply avx512vl. Extras retained; no dispatch narrowing.
All six exact ABI stub sections always decode whole. Other executable sections use sized STT_FUNC/FDE ranges; gaps remain evidence, and sections with unknown boundaries refuse.

PT_LOAD bounds, executable section offset/address correspondence and disjoint file ranges are validated before decoding. Executable segment gaps are evidence; segments without executable sections refuse.

PT_DYNAMIC and its loader-mapped string/version tables must agree with sections. Version needs validate format 1, counts, progress, boundaries, non-overlap and chain termination, while permitting LLD grouped headers.
Every big-endian ELF and ELF32 refuses. No byte-order observation axis is invented.

Metadata caps derive from input length: symbols/24, dynamic entries/16, version records/16, CIE/FDE records/8; section-note bytes are also bounded. Executable sections cannot alias; instruction decoding visits at most the file length. Symbol attribution uses a sorted disjoint interval index. Symbols are grouped by section, and overlapping FDEs are merged/indexed once to avoid per-section metadata rescans.
Evidence names truncate at a UTF-8 boundary within 256 bytes; at most 3 examples per feature and 5 gaps per section/segment view; the compact evidence document refuses above 1048576 bytes.

Rejected put verification reopens both payload storage and flow storage, verifies direct payload absence and byte-equivalent event snapshots, and rebuilds custody from the fresh events. Payload absence must be BlobNotFound/BlobNotLocal for the rejected CID, not an unrelated I/O error.

findings.decision: Refuse page-rounded virtual overlap between any PT_LOAD pair with at least one executable member, naming both program-header indices. Round each range by its p_align, or 4096 for 0/1. Overflow refuses. Sorted sweep avoids quadratic load-pair work.
findings.coverage: 8960-byte overlapping RX replacement with AVX2 at entry; disjoint adjacent pages succeed; page-only overlaps refuse for RX/RX, RX/R and R/RX, with alignments 0, 1, 4096 and 8192.

findings.decision: Charge program-header and section note payload sizes to one file-sized budget before any note iterator runs; refuse exhaustion.
findings.coverage: 1000 PT_NOTE headers aliasing 10000 valid notes refuse with the shared-budget reason. One payload succeeds; adding a section alias refuses, proving both tables use the same budget.
